titulo: Quiz — Έχετε, and then whatever you need
introPt: A traveller crosses the arrivals hall with one opening and nine different needs.

dialogo.pt: Good morning, do you have a map?
Good morning! Yes, here you are.

dialogo.es: Όχι εδώ, αλλά έχει στο περίπτερο απέναντι.
dialogo.pt: Not here, but there is some at the kiosk opposite.
dialogo.tts: Όχι εδώ, αλλά έχει στο περίπτερο απέναντι.

opcoes: A verb
The thing you want them to have
A number
Your name
perguntas.explica: The frame is έχετε plus a thing: χάρτη, φορτιστή, ψιλά, νερό, τουαλέτα. The opening itself never changes shape.

perguntas.pergunta: Greek changes the ending of a noun according to its job. What does that mean for this frame?
opcoes: You have to work out the ending at the counter
Nothing — after έχετε the ending is fixed, so you learn the pair whole
You should use the dictionary form every time
The frame only works with words that never change
perguntas.explica: Έχετε χάρτη is learned as one block, the way you learn a phone number. That χάρτη is χάρτης in the dictionary can be ignored for the whole trip.

perguntas.pergunta: «Όχι εδώ, αλλά έχει στο περίπτερο απέναντι.» What should you do?
opcoes: Thank them and walk off
Ask again more slowly
Stay one beat — the no carries the address of the yes
Try a different language
perguntas.explica: The first word is only the first half. The useful part is the kiosk opposite, the other terminal, the machine that does break a twenty.

perguntas.pergunta: A kiosk says cash only. What does Greek law actually oblige?
opcoes: Nothing — accepting card is always the trader's choice
Owning a terminal, but not using it
Accepting card payment for a long list of trades, with visible notice at the door and till
Accepting card only above twenty euros
perguntas.explica: The duty is to accept, not merely to own a terminal, and it attaches to the trade's activity code — widened at the end of 2023 to cover markets, food retail and kiosks. It is broad, not universal.

perguntas.pergunta: What belongs in front of the frame at every counter?
opcoes: Παρακαλώ
Συγγνώμη
Καλημέρα
Ευχαριστώ
perguntas.explica: The greeting comes first, every time. Arriving with the request and no καλημέρα is entering without knocking.
